name: University of Melbourne long-term student loan
summary: An interest-free loan of up to $5,000, with a guarantor, for unexpected study-related costs.
who: Current enrolment at the University of Melbourne.
Not on leave, cross-institutional, living overseas or under 18.
how: Apply online with your student ID and your guarantor's ID, address, residency and income proof.
catches: Limited to $3,000 if your guarantor isn't an Australian citizen or PR or lives overseas.
Citizens and PRs can repay after finishing their course; others must repay before finishing.
Can't be used for tuition fees.

evidence.quote: The maximum amount you can borrow is $5,000, depending on your guarantor.
